body:
Astoria contained dummy-enquiry proof — 27 October 2026

The fresh Netlify preview exposed a GitHub clone failure (Repository not found), which the earlier saved-link check had not detected. Reconnected the same repository using existing authorization; fresh builds now succeed. PR7 is merged and production deployment 6ae05b31900c697e170cae95 is published at c96233aa1a89c3ab3a9cd6883d064f5715bcf873.

The protected diagnostic uses the real accepted-lead service and signed XeroFlow receiver with a simulated CRM response and isolated test storage. All 93 repository tests passed. Production exercised contact, stock, model-variant, rejection, transport retry and duplicate receipt scenarios. The duplicate acknowledgement initially failed; its retained envelope recovered through a manual same-core retry, returning HTTP 200 / duplicate with exactly one lead. This does not prove scheduled-job invocation.

Readback: six flagged test leads total (one preview plus five accepted production fixtures), no rejected lead, zero sales-rule deliveries, zero CRM links, zero conversion events and zero conversion deliveries. Eight isolated test-storage keys were removed and zero remain. No real CRM enquiry or production conversion was created.

QA stays open for actual legacy CRM acceptance/hook ownership, controlled browser acceptance and consented GA4/provider reporting. Synthetic success is bounded server-delivery proof; it is not a full customer-path pass. Existing live measurement profile remains enabled. Status, assignee and due date are unchanged.

Source: https://github.com/adme-dev/astoria-gwm/pull/7
Committed ledger and receipts: https://github.com/adme-dev/dashboard/blob/7f333d52a4e65d4c7c8d98def7a5979f4b5220e2/docs/runbooks/ita-dealer-completion-ledger-20261026.md#astoria-contained-synthetic-diagnostics--27-october-07580810-utc
